has_offset.reason: The output uses page-based pagination with `page` and `limit` parameters. Offset-based pagination (where you specify `offset` as the starting position) is not implemented. While page-based pagination can mathematically achieve offset behavior (offset = (page - 1) * limit), the criterion explicitly requires `has_offset`, which typically means an explicit `offset` query parameter should be present.
has_offset.feedback: To satisfy the has_offset criterion, implement offset-based pagination by adding an `offset` query parameter (e.g., `?offset=0&limit=20`) alongside or instead of page-based pagination. This would allow clients to directly specify the starting position in the result set.
